2609.31397.title: Intent2Tc: Automated Intent-to-Traffic Control Translation with Language Models
2609.31397.paper_summary: Automated and highly usable Quality-of-Service (QoS) enforcement requires translating high-level service intents into deployable traffic-management policies. Although intent-based networking (IBN) has simplified policy specification, bridging the gap between business-level intents and executable network configurations remains complex, error-prone, and difficult to automate. This paper presents Intent2Tc, a closed-loop language-model-driven framework that translates business-level traffic-shaping intents into declarative sub-intents and subsequently into validated, executable Linux traffic control (tc) configurations. The framework integrates an Active Queue Management (AQM)-based digital twin (DT) semantic model, automated metadata extraction, critique-driven refinement, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based knowledge reuse to improve semantic consistency and configuration reliability. We evaluate multiple open-source large language models (LLMs) and small language models (SLMs), together with Claude Sonnet-4.6, on 100 Request for Comments (RFC) 9315-compliant traffic-shaping intents. Across both translation stages, Intent2Tc achieves high semantic fidelity, configuration accuracy, and deployment readiness, with Claude Sonnet-4.6 reaching 0.98 semantic similarity, 1.0 semantic unit coverage, and 0.045 normalized edit distance. Furthermore, RAG reduces token consumption and inference latency while enabling compact models such as Phi-4-mini to approach the performance of substantially larger models. Linux tc serves as the target configuration platform, demonstrating the practical applicability of the proposed framework.
2609.31397.paper_summary_zh: 自動化和高度可用的服務質量 (QoS) 執行需要將高層次的服務意圖轉換為可部署的流量管理政策。儘管基於意圖的網絡 (IBN) 簡化了政策規範，但在商業層次的意圖與可執行的網絡配置之間架起橋樑仍然複雜、易出錯且難以自動化。本文提出了 Intent2Tc，一個閉環語言模型驅動的框架，將商業層次的流量塑形意圖轉換為聲明式子意圖，並隨後轉換為經過驗證的可執行 Linux 流量控制 (tc) 配置。該框架整合了一個基於主動佇列管理 (AQM) 的數位雙胞胎 (DT) 語義模型、自動化元數據提取、批評驅動的精煉以及基於檢索增強生成 (RAG) 的知識重用，以提高語義一致性和配置可靠性。我們評估了多個開源大型語言模型 (LLMs) 和小型語言模型 (SLMs)，以及 Claude Sonnet-4.6，在 100 個符合 RFC 9315 的流量塑形意圖上。 在兩個翻譯階段中，Intent2Tc 實現了高語義保真度、配置準確性和部署準備性，Claude Sonnet-4.6 的語義相似度達到 0.98，語義單元覆蓋率為 1.0，標準化編輯距離為 0.045。此外，RAG 減少了令牌消耗和推理延遲，同時使得像 Phi-4-mini 這樣的緊湊模型能夠接近大得多模型的性能。Linux tc 作為目標配置平台，展示了所提出框架的實際應用性。
